_what: The models this box is SUPPOSED to have, and what each one IS. Declared state, not a snapshot: `python3 scripts/models.py ensure` makes the box match this file.
_why: Sampling used to be resolved by matching a family name inside the tag string, so `ollama cp` produced tags with identical weights, no family name and no profile -- they ran on backend defaults Qwen's own docs forbid. The fix is to pin WHAT A TAG IS rather than infer it from what it is called. The digest is the identity; the name is a label a person typed.

base_models._server: Moved to the ThinkPad eGPU 2026-10-13 (Jas) to free 4-5 GB of the GX10's pool for builds; read by memory.embed_url()

base_models.role: every model role (Jas, 2026-10-06: 'let Swift work everything from Scoping to your final QC')
base_models.weight_gb_source: MemAvailable fell ~95 GB from start to serving, PLE prewarmed (2026-10-06); the engine pid holds 84,531 MiB (gpu_gate)

pin._what: files = sha256(config.json + model.safetensors.index.json)[:16] of the served dir; image = the built image id. models.py verify compares both; a rebuilt dir or image is DRIFT until re-pinned.

base_models._includes_kv: vLLM pre-allocates a fixed 16 GiB KV pool (serve.FLAGS kv_bytes); weight_gb was measured with it allocated and the PLE prewarmed.

base_models.role: Swift Jr: Swift 1.5 (Qwen3.8-27B) GGUF Q4_K_M on the ThinkPad eGPU, num_ctx 57344; replaces Q4 in the Auditor role (Jas, 2026-10-22)
base_models.weight_gb_source: /api/ps size_vram 18.16 GB at context 57344 on the ThinkPad, 2026-10-22; 62.7 tok/s on a one-word reply; eGPU total 24,463 MiB

_type: What a model is FOR (Jas, 2026-10-07): 'llm' (reads and writes text: every role task but indexing) or 'embedder' (turns text, and for some, images, into vectors: corpus indexing). task_routing.TASK_MODEL_TYPES says which types each task takes; the Models tab offers a role only those.

not_served.note: Approved by Jas 2026-10-07 for embedding non-text files (images: 6/6, workspace/embed-eval/RESULTS.md). On disk with its own venv (~/models/eg2-venv); no server yet, so no role can run it.
